name: lognorth
description: Read your production logs from inside your coding agent: alerts, issues, failing requests, and traces from your self-hosted LogNorth.

LOGNORTH_URL.title: LogNorth URL
LOGNORTH_URL.description: Your LogNorth address, for example https://logs.yoursite.com

LOGNORTH_AGENT_KEY.title: Agent key
LOGNORTH_AGENT_KEY.description: Read-only key from Settings > Developer in LogNorth. Starts with lgn-agent-.
